name: chiikawa
description: Chiikawa mode: Hachiware conducts, and the friends from Chiikawa appear as text drawings to take on tasks and talk them over (Claude subagents + Orca workers). In English, Korean and Japanese.

language.title: Language
language.description: One of auto, en, ko, ja. auto (the default) follows, in this order: the language chosen with /chiikawa lang, the letters of the prompts you type (Hangul for Korean, kana for Japanese), Claude Code's own language setting, the LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG environment variables, and English. Anything else is read as auto

leaderVoice.title: Hachiware's voice
leaderVoice.description: The main session talks in the voice of Hachiware, the conductor

politeLeader.title: Polite Hachiware
politeLeader.description: Hachiware speaks politely instead of in the casual speech of the comic

memberVoice.title: The friends' voices
memberVoice.description: A subagent reports in the voice of the character cast for it (a friend who cannot talk reports with a sound)

orcaVoice.title: Orca workers' voices
orcaVoice.description: A fleet-run launch is handed a copy of its spec, made beside it, with the character's voice added at the end

band.title: Band of friends above the prompt
band.description: Shows one row above the prompt with the friends' names (press one to see what that friend is doing), who takes the next prompt (auto by default) and the usage; while the pane is closed, the last line said is drawn under it as one cut

trio.title: The three together
trio.description: Shows light work the main session does itself as Hachiware, Chiikawa and Usagi at it together (Usagi for tools that search, Chiikawa for tools that edit)

animate.title: Movement while working
animate.description: The picture and the icon of a character at work move every half second (turned off, only that movement stops: the screen is still redrawn when a task or a tool call changes it, when you press something, and by the check that runs every 2 seconds)

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: One of auto, dark, light. auto (the default) follows the Claude Code theme (a theme with light in its name is a light one). Set light if the colors look faint on a light terminal

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: The status pane opens by itself when a friend is handed work (once closed by hand, it is not opened again until /chiikawa)
